epic.summary: Cash Settlement based on Average Price

business_context: Corner changes FX Spot instruments from FIFO-based profit/loss to average-price (weighted average) cash settlement semantics: configurable method per instrument class, formulas for average fill, open P/L, % P/L gross, and weighted-average ladders for realized P/L—with Yogi CRT-1738–CRT-1743 defining authoritative math and defaults.

synthesis.problem_gist: PL for FX Spot should follow average-price (weighted average) rules driven by functional configuration rather than FIFO-only, spanning average fill, open P/L, % P/L gross, and realized P/L ladders for cash-settled flows.

impact_areas.text: Functional configuration distinguishes FIFO-calculated versus WeightedAvg-calculated instruments (defaults to FIFO when unset).
Position metrics exposed in trading UIs depend on Average Fill Price, Open P/L, % P/L gross, Realized P/L formulas under FIFO vs WeightedAvg.
Historical ladder / crossing-zero behavior for averages and rounding dependencies per CRT-1738.

requirements.snippet_text: Average Price, Open PL and Realized PL during cash settlement (for non-equity cash flow) are calculated by weighted average for the instrument types configured accordingly in . The Weighted Average algorithm assumes that PL for each closing trade for the whole history of a position should be calculated based on average position price and not the opening price of the matched opening trades. Only opening trades contributes to position average price. See rounding rules: for average price calculation - according to ; for realized PL - according to ; for open PL - according to . Example the following position history from the moment the position was flat (zero size): 1) BUY +10 @ 99.00 => position: long 10 2) BUY +10 @ 98.00 => position: long 20 3a) SELL -20 @ 99.50 => position: 0 3b) SELL -10 @ 99.50 => position: short 10 4) SELL -10 @ 98.50 => position: short 20 5a) BUY +10 @ 97.25 => position: short 10 5b) BUY +15 @ 98 => position: long 5 6) BUY +10 @ 99.50 => position: long 15 Ask = 99 Bid = 97 Average price and PL calculations for each point: Trade sequence Trade side Trade size Trade price Position net size Position average price Realized PL Effect

obligations_proposed.statement: Functional configuration maps FOREX FX_SPOT to WeightedAvg calculation; FIFO remains default for unconfigured types; skip scenarios that remap existing instrument types.
Average fill price for WeightedAvg instruments uses opening trades since last net-size zero crossing; FIFO path uses FIFO open-lot contribution.
Open P/L for WeightedAvg uses position_qty * (mark price - average fill price) * multiplier per CRT-1743.
% P/L gross rounds to two decimals per CRT-1742 denominator rules.
Changing account group membership (e.g. OPPORTUNITY vs ENERGY routing context) does not alter existing open position average fill price or open P/L inputs for the same open lots.
